experiences.position: Partnerships Lead, Agency Partnerships, North America

experiences.description:
•	Relocated to New York to take on a leading role in setting up, growing and developing the Customer Success team with a focus on coaching new and existing team members and empowering them with the necessary tools, information, knowledge and attitude to build a positive work culture and retain satisfied customers. 
•	Managed a portfolio of 15 multi-faceted global insight community accounts within the Media, CPG, Retail, Health and Finance space, representative of the more complex and high profiled accounts in Customer Success
•	Closely involved with onboarding customers and aligning customer business objectives with Vision Critical technology to provide enterprise-wide solutions  and maximize value from their investment
•	Acquired a clear understanding of customer business needs and corporate goals to provide strategic recommendations for account development and growth.
•	Executed on company goals including revenue expansion, churn reduction, higher user adoption, customer satisfaction, financial profitability and team growth.
•	Collaborated with all levels within the Customer Success team, Sales, Marketing, and R&D groups, to stay abreast of current industry trends, customer business needs, voice of customer needs, and increase expertise within the insight community space to provide customers with best practices, strategic direction and ongoing support.

•	Exhibited strong understanding of Vision Critical’s Technology platforms with the ability to empower customers to leverage the tool(s) to make data-driven decisions that directly impact their business goals
•	Successfully launched insight communities for Canadian Tire, Corus Entertainment, Sony Music, IU Health, Harvard Pilgrim, Ascend Learning, E.W. Scripps, Parade Magazine and Keybank.  Worked with customers and internal teams at Vision Critical to create a branded community, recruit members and develop on-going engagement strategy
•	Managed both research and survey management projects congruently to ensure they remained within scope, on time and within budget
•	Upsold additional products and services to further solidify the relationship with customers and continue to look for new opportunities to deepen partnership
•	Prevented churn of accounts by going above-and-beyond to exhibit value and ROI with key stakeholders
